name: Shunkyoku no Tyrhhia - Gensaku Digital Novel
original_name: 瞬旭のティルヒア 原作デジタルノベル
source: A standalone visual novel version of a [url=https://www.liar.co.jp/tyrhhia/book01.html]doujin short story[/url] by Sakurai Hikaru originally published in 2011. It would later serve as a base for Shunkyoku no Tyrhhia ~What a Beautiful Dawn~.
translation: 樱井光的[url=https://www.liar.co.jp/tyrhhia/book01.html]同人短篇小说[/url]的独立视觉小说版本，最初于2011年出版。它后来成为《Shunkyoku no Tyrhhia ~What a Beautiful Dawn~》的基础。
